episode.ask: Can you help me find them?

finds.action_line: The frog can hop! Can you hop too?
The duck can flap! Can you flap too?
The sheep can wiggle! Can you wiggle too?

gag_lines: Ha ha! You got me again!
finds.action_line: The horse can stomp! Can you stomp too?

gag_lines: Hmm? Who is hiding in there?
finds.action_line: The cat can spin! Can you spin too?
The bird can flap! Can you flap too?
The rooster can dance! Can you dance too?

lines: Hop and jump and clap your hands,
Stomp your feet, stomp the ground,
Wave your arms and wiggle now,
Flap your wings and march along,
Stretch up high, touch the sky,
Clap and dance to our fun song,

finale: Thank you for finding all my friends!
Thank you, friends! I love you!
episode.teaser_line: Next time, a new friend comes to play!
